epk.title: What is an EPK?
epk.subtitle: Electronic Press Kit
epk.description: An <0>EPK</0> is your band's professional digital business card. It gathers everything festival bookers, concert venues, journalists, and labels need to discover you in one place.
epk.bioPhotosDesc: Your story, members, and downloadable press visuals.
epk.audioClipsDesc: Your best tracks and integrated live performances.
epk.shareDesc: A unique interactive link ready to be sent to professionals.
epk.bannerDesc: To make things easier, <0>Roadie</0> guides and advises you step by step throughout creation. An <1>intelligent interactive tool</1> is at your disposal to design an impactful press kit effortlessly!

techRider.title: What is a Technical Rider?
techRider.subtitle: Technical Rider & Stage Plan
techRider.description: The <0>technical rider</0> lists all your band's equipment and logistical needs on stage. It is the essential document sent to venue sound engineers and technicians to ensure a perfect sound on show day.
techRider.patchDesc: Detailed list of your console inputs, desired microphones, and monitors.
techRider.stagePlanDesc: Exact visual layout of musicians, amplifiers, and power outlets.
techRider.bannerDesc: No need to be a sound engineer! <0>Roadie</0> accompanies you step by step to build your patch line and generate a clear <1>interactive stage plan</1> complying with professional standards.
